name: Animal Battle Stats
pitch: Who would win? Fight it out with real animals. Every animal is a real photo card that rides into each duel on your Ranger's craft: strike, block, parry on the glint, break its guard and finish it with your animal's own ultimate.

videos.title: A duel won by skill: strike, block, parry
THE NINTH TOWER: a voiced story
Collect them all: real photo cards

features.title: Real animals, real photo cards
features.text: Every animal in the game comes from this site as a real photo card with its real stats, so research here changes the game.

features.title: Duels won by skill
features.text: Light chains, heavy blows, parries, guard breaks and finishers: strike, block, parry on the glint, break its guard and finish it with your animal's own ultimate.

features.title: Every animal fights like itself
features.text: From its real weight, speed and power, with its own named ultimate.

features.title: Ride nine islands
features.text: Beat the wild animals, the gate champions and each island's guardian on its summit.

features.title: THE NINTH TOWER
features.text: A voiced story across every island.

features.title: Friends and the league
features.text: Ride with friends, fight side by side or duel each other live. The day's hunt, the week's trial and the league's boards. Plays upright or sideways on phones.

features.title: Level your cards
features.text: Level your cards, fit your rig at the bench and collect them all. No loot boxes: nothing random is ever sold, and nothing in the store is power that play cannot earn.
